department: Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Computer Science PhD)

deadline.value: Fall priority deadline is December 15, 2026; later applications are accepted but may miss fellowships and assistantships.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional but highly recommended.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are optional but highly recommended

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: International applicants need a TOEFL iBT score of at least 90.
toefl_min.quote: scores at or above 90 on internet-based exam

supervisor.value: Students choose a research cluster and adviser during the program, not before admission.
supervisor.quote: encouraged to choose a research cluster and dissertation topic as early in the graduate program as possible

funding.value: More than 75 percent of EECS graduate students are supported by assistantships or fellowships.
funding.quote: More than 75 percent of EECS graduate students are supported by assistantships or fellowships

entry_route.value: Applicants normally hold an undergraduate degree in the field; the page lists no master's requirement.
